title: DPRK destroyer fleet analysis — 5,000t class, 3rd at Nampo, combat readiness questions
snippet: Satellite analysis of North Korea's 5,000-ton destroyer program. Cho Hyon (first) testing and sailing on west coast. Third destroyer being assembled at Nampo. Kim Jong Un announces 2+ destroyers per year. Combat readiness questioned — sensors and weapons integration incomplete. Second destroyer damaged in failed launch at Chongjin.
tag_reason: New comprehensive analysis of DPRK destroyer program with satellite imagery, includes unreported detail on second destroyer incident at Chongjin
